hypotheses.strongest_evidence: Truth property, reflectivity, seismic, and gravity responses exactly reproduce the inversion observations.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: None in the audited noiseless inverse-crime operators.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: Hard cosine decode equals soft-probability top-1 at all audited temperatures and states; one-hot property and acoustic mappings are exact for every category.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: None; subsurface air exclusion was audited separately and also passed.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: Float64 finite differences match autograd through all five audited chains, all signs match, and every small negative-gradient step descends.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: None after the representable float32 probe was separated from the authoritative float64 finite-difference audit.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: The applied physics update is aligned with raw negative gradient and lowers the local soft objective before and after the actual Euler dt.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: A controller-sized unit-time step changes hard physics adversely, showing that scale can cross categorical boundaries even though its sign and implemented Euler semantics are correct.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: D3 pre/post projection losses are identical and projection erasure is zero; D4 also has zero pre/post projection physics-loss delta.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: D4 state-space projection corrections are nonzero because the U-Net velocity moves conditioned voxels, reaching norm 7.1976, but exact acoustic overwrite makes their observation-loss erasure zero.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: Correct seismic full-flow BASE_PLUS_PHYSICS reaches only 30.64% maximum and 11.52% final hard attainment; the native case reaches 31.48%/14.44%.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: The free endpoint reference reaches 58.78% hard attainment, but zero and shuffled endpoints reach 64.47% and 58.52%, so this is not correct-observation-specific recovery.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: At the seismic level D3 finishes with 19.09% soft attainment but -0.80% hard attainment; reflectivity reaches 10.80% soft but 0% hard.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: Probability, expected-property, and blurred-property levels cross the hard boundary and attain approximately 100%, so the gap is operator/representation dependent rather than universal.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: D3 seismic soft loss continues to improve while the final step has zero hard flips and raw gradient norm 2.70e-7; the best hard step has only 64 target crossings.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: Earlier property levels cross boundaries completely, and full-flow D4 makes many crossings, so saturation is a primary bottleneck in the isolated seismic embedding trace but not the only full-flow mechanism.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: The D4 correct full-flow endpoint differs from paired BASE at 14,055 labels, with 12,005 flips ending outside the target class; earlier all-class Q3 also used eight categories while producing only 256 target voxels.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: At D3 best hard seismic step all 64 flips enter raw label 9 and none enter a wrong lithology, so substitution is not the first generator-free failure.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: At D3 best hard seismic step 99.9996% of gradient energy and 97.54% of the applied update lie in the hidden-body ROI; condition energy is zero.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: The first update is diffuse (72.37% outside target ROIs), but the gradient localizes as the run proceeds without yielding adequate hard attainment.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: Low-dimensional Q1 exactly recovers both hidden bodies with correct seismic, whereas free embedding/full-flow searches do not; the native final target IoU remains 0.0557.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: The free high-dimensional endpoint reduces hard loss by 58.78%, so the space is not completely immobile; however zero/shuffled controls improve just as much or more.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: All valid interfaces remain inside the recording window and cropped-interface fraction is zero; TWT, spike, and wavelet residuals all respond strongly to optimization.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: Arrival TWT RMSE remains about 30 ms at the best/final D3 states, but this is residual misfit rather than cropping or a dead zone.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: D3 observed hard seismic loss is best at step 126 (2.44% paired attainment) and deteriorates by step 200 (-0.80%); in D4 the paired causal advantage peaks at 30.64% at step 23 and falls to 11.52% at step 32.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: D4 absolute observed hard loss continues improving through step 32, so its observation-only best checkpoint is the final step; only its advantage relative to paired BASE is destroyed.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: The required causal pattern is absent: MATCHED_NORM_PHYSICS_ONLY reaches only 9.30% maximum hard attainment, whereas BASE_PLUS_PHYSICS reaches 30.64%.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: At individual late steps the base flow can erase part of the immediate soft improvement, but aggregate paired performance is better with the flow than without it.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: All eight native-conditioned prior samples contain target label beyond conditions and seven contain a native-size-compatible component; the StructuralGeo-native target nevertheless reproduces the cuboid failure.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: Native prior topology is diffuse (53-68 connected components and frequent oversized components), so fine shape/topology support is imperfect even though coarse occurrence/size support is present.

hypotheses.strongest_evidence: The guided full-flow response does not fit the truth response, so the required precondition for using nonuniqueness as the primary explanation is absent; Q0/Q1 also identifies and exactly recovers the true structured pair.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: Zero and shuffled controls can reduce their own losses, demonstrating a broad objective landscape, but no distinct geology with an exact correct-truth physics fit was established.

ranked_failure_mechanisms.mechanism: insufficient and observation-nonspecific physics attainment on the high-dimensional frozen-flow state
soft-hard transfer and categorical decision-boundary saturation beginning at reflectivity/TWT
D3 best-iterate destruction and loss of D4 paired causal advantage late in the trajectory
wrong-lithology substitution in the full all-class flow trajectory
imperfect native prior topology support, secondary rather than cuboid-specific primary cause
